lines: Verse 1
I spent my younger years like a fist through glass
Tryin’ to outrun ghosts with a heavy foot on the gas
Thought every hard goodbye meant somethin’ broke in me
But the things that nearly killed me only taught me how to breathe
Had a head full of thunder, had a throat full of blame
Had a heart like a wildfire callin’ everybody’s name
Still I woke up every mornin’ with a shovel and a scar
Tryin’ to find a little mercy in the wreckage where we are
Pre-Chorus
Some nights the darkness talks loud
Like it owns every road I’ve known
But hope… that stubborn bastard…
Still keeps leavin’ the porch light on
Chorus
I don’t know how to act my age
Hell, I’ve never been this old
Still chasin’ sparks through desert dark
Still reachin’ for fool’s gold
Maybe growin’ old ain’t growin’ up
Maybe nobody knows
I don’t know how to act my age…
I’ve never been this old
Verse 2
Now I’m standin’ out in Arizona with a woman that I love
In a tent big enough for dreams and all the things we’re scared of
We laughed so hard we damn near cried when the whole thing turned our way
Said, “We fuckin’ did it, baby…” and I still hear it today
Not solved, not safe, not over
Still a long road left to ride
But somethin’ in my bones got quiet
Like home had moved inside
Pre-Chorus 2
And through the lens of fading hope
That refused to go softly into that good night
I found grace in the breakin’
And somehow… I survived
Chorus
I don’t know how to act my age
Hell, I’ve never been this old
Still chasin’ sparks through desert dark
Still reachin’ for fool’s gold
Maybe growin’ old ain’t growin’ up
Maybe nobody knows
I don’t know how to act my age…
I’ve never been this old
Bridge (Nathaniel-style emotional punch)
I thought home was a place you found
Some county line, some patch of ground
But home was hidin’ underneath
Every wound that wouldn’t leave
And if I go before I planned
Tell ‘em I loved with both my hands
Tell ‘em hope was bruised and tired…
But hope still burned like sacred fire
Final Chorus (lift)
I don’t know how to act my age
Hell, I’ve never been this old
Still holdin’ hands with broken faith
Still stubborn in my soul
And if growin’ old means givin’ up
Well hell, that ain’t how this goes
I don’t know how to act my age…
I’ve never been this old.
